init.title: IoX Options
init.description: Set the options for the IoX integration.

data_description.sensor_string: Any device or folder containing this string in its name is treated as a sensor or binary sensor.
data_description.ignore_string: Any device containing this string in its name is ignored.
data_description.restore_light_state: Restore the previous brightness when turning on a light instead of the device's built-in On Level.
data_description.enable_variables: Disable to skip loading variable entities (faster startup if you don't use them).
data_description.enable_programs: Disable to skip loading program entities (faster startup if you don't use them).
data_description.enable_networking: Disable to skip loading network resource entities (faster startup if you don't use them).

send_node_command.name: Send node command
send_node_command.description: Send a friendly-named command to an IoX device by entity ID. Valid commands: beep, brighten, dim, disable, enable, fade_down, fade_stop, fade_up, fast_off, fast_on, query.

command.name: Command
command.description: The command to send to the device.

get_node_commands.name: Get node commands
get_node_commands.description: Return the IoX commands a node accepts. The response's 'accepted_commands' maps each canonical wire id (e.g. DON, OL, BEEP — what 'Send raw node command' expects) to its human-readable name.

rename_node.name: Rename node
rename_node.description: Rename the underlying IoX node or scene. The controller emits a lifecycle event afterwards; the integration's Repair card will prompt you to reload so HA's caches catch up.

set_zwave_parameter.name: Set Z-Wave parameter
set_zwave_parameter.description: Write a Z-Wave configuration parameter on the targeted entity's node. Uses the dedicated controller endpoint that carries the parameter's byte size — so multi-byte parameters round-trip correctly. The post-write parameter report arrives asynchronously on the controller's event stream.

value.name: Value
value.description: Parameter value to write (signed integer; the device interprets the sign per its parameter spec).

size.name: Size (bytes)
size.description: Parameter byte size as defined by the device — 1, 2, or 4.

get_zwave_parameter.name: Get Z-Wave parameter
get_zwave_parameter.description: Request the current value of a Z-Wave configuration parameter. Returns a parameter / size / value dict on success; raises on controller failure (404 / device unreachable / unknown parameter).

send_program_command.name: Send program command
send_program_command.description: Send a verb (run, run_then, run_else, stop, enable, disable, …) to a program or folder by id or name.

address.name: Program id
address.description: The program or folder id (e.g. 0030). Takes precedence over name when both are given.

name.name: Program name
name.description: Exact name of the program or folder. Used when no id is given.

command.name: Command
command.description: The verb to send. Folders only accept run / stop / enable / disable.

isy.name: Controller
isy.description: If you have more than one IoX controller, the controller UUID to target.
